meta.description: Alexis Carella - DevOps / Platform Engineer. Kubernetes, observability, security (ISO 27001 / DORA / MiCA), GitOps, FinOps.
meta.title: CV - Alexis Carella

about.bio: DevOps / Platform Engineer - From system administration and bare-metal to Kubernetes platform engineering, observability, and regulated compliance (ISO 27001 / DORA / MiCA).

experience.title: Platform / System Engineer
bullets: Kubernetes Platform Engineering: Migrated production infrastructure from OVH Public Cloud to Scaleway (2024), led the production migration to Kubernetes (2022), onboarded multiple products on Scaleway Kapsule across 7+ namespaces. GitOps with ArgoCD, Kustomize (dev/staging/preprod/prod), Sealed Secrets, and documented rollback procedures.

End-to-end Observability: VictoriaMetrics / Prometheus / Grafana stack, VMAlert alerting routed to Microsoft Teams, OpenTelemetry + Loki pipeline for Laravel application logs, SMS alerting via Cloudflare Workers, PromQL-based cron monitoring, uptime dashboards, and weekly log review with a formalised checklist.

Security & Compliance (Regulated Context): Contributed to ISO 27001 certification, PASSI audit remediation, vulnerability management with SentinelOne, Trivy/Kubescape cluster scanning, Zero Trust back-office access (Cloudflare Access), server hardening, script signing policy - all within the DORA / MiCA regulatory framework.

Incident Management & SRE: Authored post-mortems (CoreDNS dual failure, Redis SPOF, Scaleway infrastructure incidents, application outages), produced availability reports for ISMS (SMSI) compliance under ISO 27001 / DORA / MiCA.
Databases: PostgreSQL replication setup, automated GDPR anonymisation pipeline, MariaDB MaxScale proxy architecture, Redis / Valkey high-availability clusters, custom permission repair tooling.
FinOps: Led 2 cloud cost optimisation studies (2025, 2026) covering right-sizing, reserved instances, and resource consolidation.

Software Engineering: Cloudflare Workers (JS) - webhook orchestration and alerting bridges for financial services; PromQL / Go templating; bash hardening scripts; CI pipeline management (Bitbucket runners); SonarQube deployment; Docker image unification roadmap.

Documentation & Knowledge Management: Authored 100+ Confluence pages (runbooks, onboarding guides, dev workflow documentation, JSM configuration, internal DevOps training sessions). Adopted modern AI tools: Claude Code skills, MCP integrations (Grafana, Atlassian), AI-assisted log analysis workflows.
